verses.text: The LORD of Armies gave me another message.
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "I am very jealous for Zion. I am burning with jealousy for her."
This is what the LORD says: "I will return to Zion and live in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the Faithful City, and the mountain of the LORD of Armies will be called the Holy Mountain."
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "Once again old men and old women will sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each with a walking stick in hand because of their age.
The city streets will be filled with boys and girls playing there."
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "It may seem amazing to the survivors of this people at that time, but will it seem amazing to me?" says the LORD of Armies.
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "I will save my people from the countries of the east and the west.
I will bring them back to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their faithful and righteous God."

This is what the LORD of Armies says: "Be strong, all of you who are now hearing these words from the prophets who spoke when the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD of Armies, so that the temple could be built.
Before that time, there were no wages for people or for animals. No one could go about their business safely because of their enemies. I had turned everyone against their neighbor.
But now I will not treat the survivors of this people as I did before," says the LORD of Armies.
"The seed will grow well. The vine will produce its fruit, the ground will produce its crops, and the sky will give its dew. I will give all these things to the survivors of this people.
People of Judah and people of Israel, just as you were a curse among the nations, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid. Be strong."
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to bring disaster on you, and I did not change my mind," says the LORD of Armies.
"So now I have decided to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.
These are the things you must do: Tell each other the truth. In your courts, give judgments that are true and bring peace.
Do not plot evil against each other, and do not love to swear falsely. I hate all these things," says the LORD.
The LORD of Armies gave me another message.
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months will become happy celebrations and joyful festivals for the people of Judah. So love truth and peace."
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "People from many nations and many cities will still come.
People from one city will go to another and say, 'Let us go right away to ask for the LORD's favor and to look for the LORD of Armies. I am going too.'
Many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to look for the LORD of Armies and to ask for his favor."

This is what the LORD of Armies says: "In those days ten people from every language and nation will grab the robe of one Jew and say, 'Let us go with you, because we have heard that God is with you.'"
